lines.text: God tells Isaiah to confront Shebna, the palace steward, for carving out a tomb for himself in the rock.
God will shake Shebna violently, roll him into a ball, and sling him into a wide land to die.
God will remove Shebna from office and summon His servant Eliakim son of Shaphan.
God will clothe Eliakim with Shebna's robe and sash and place the key to the house of Aaron on him.
God will drive Eliakim like a peg into a firm place, but that peg will later give way and fall.
